text:
elena: Bringing up lumen50b (int6) into warm canary — seeing warmstart OOMs + small eval quality drop.

elena: Config used:
```
model: lumen50b-quant-int6
batch_size: 8
max_new_tokens: 512
continuous_batching: true
kv_prefetch: true
slot_compaction: false
``` 

elena: Error snippet from node-42:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. failed to allocate 2147483648 bytes
free_slots: 2/64 (fragmentation high)
peak_mem: 79.1GB
```

raj: which instance types? and is this on coldstart or warmstart?

elena: it's on warmstart (traffic ramp). nodes are a40-rtx-32GB equiv. observed steady mem ~77GB then spike to 79.

tom: try dropping max_new_tokens to 256 and batch_size to 4 for the canary. also enable slot_compaction and lower continuous_batching.window_ms to 10.

sasha: small quality note — int6 calibration sometimes shifts topk logits slightly; could explain the ~0.8–1.2% rouge drop we saw. re-run eval with calibration enabled (`--calibrate=true`) before we blame batching.

elena: quick eval (subset):
int8 baseline Rouge-L: 42.7
int6 current    Rouge-L: 41.8
several long-span summarization cases truncated/under-generated.

raj: can we soft-fallback to int8 on mem > 85% or during the first 5m of warmstart? safer than full rollback.

ops-bot: [ALERT] Canary lumen50b-int6 paused (OOM alerts > 3) — automated rollback on hold pending triage.

elena: proposed plan:
1) reduce max_new_tokens -> 256 and batch_size -> 4 for warm canary
2) enable slot_compaction + continuous_batching.window_ms=10
3) run calibration and full eval harness
4) if mem still spikes, route new warm requests to int8 for first 5m

tom: i'll open a PR to set `slot_compaction=true` and `soft_kv_evict=true`, and flip default warm max_new_tokens to 256 for lumen50b canary.

sasha: I'll run the calibrate+eval pipeline now and post results (~30m).

elena: thanks — will monitor logs, tagging @tom @sasha for updates. :thumbsup:
